text.tspan: PC-STGNN: Physics-Consistent Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network for Sensor-Robust Fault Localization
① Offline physics operator: fixed, built once, never trained
μ[f, τ, R, L, i, p] p.u., μ
ρ for every window × k ∈ {0,1,2,5,10} × 3 seeds
k ~ U{0, 1, 2, 5} per batch; zero all 6
channels of k random nodes → X̃, mask (0,0,0)
keep clean X and drop mask D ∈ {0,1}
, fitted on A only, against the clean values on dropped channels D
⇒ leave-k-out physics consistency. Exactly 0 when |D| = 0 (all k = 0 batches).
has zero gradient (f̂ is an arg-min index).

⑥ Training objective: gradient reaches the network only through z and P
CE: per-node cross-entropy, event label shared by all 25 nodes
: expected physics residual on the available sensors A
: expected residual on held-out sensors D (leave-k-out)
